_readme: One home for every site photo: file name, crop, alt text and caption. `python3 _src/photos.py <folder of originals>` writes the WebP files to assets/img/; page sources show photos with <!--photos key key-->. Crop boxes are fractions of the original (left, top, right, bottom). Alt text says what is in the photo; no city names, because the job locations aren't recorded. Originals: Twin Rivers Facebook photos, supplied 2026-10-21.
